sections.Profile:
"Twin-Gain" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Recel S.A. in 1977. The game accommodates a single player and features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, two vari-targets, and a standup target.

- Manufacturer: Recel S. A.
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Gambling, Original Theme, 1970s, Money
